name: rules.bank_switch

list.description: Read complete native bank-switch source trees with correlated local selection.

parameters.name: source-account
parameters.description: Exact whole-string source identity. Case-sensitive; repeated values OR, fields AND; literal *; no comma splitting or trimming.

parameters.name: source-network
parameters.description: Exact requirement network; requires a child rule in the same requirement. Case-sensitive; repeated values OR, fields AND; literal *; no comma splitting or trimming.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact rule status in the same requirement and rule as other nested predicates. Case-sensitive; repeated values OR, fields AND; literal *; no comma splitting or trimming.

parameters.name: target-account
parameters.description: Exact target account in the same target as target-network. Case-sensitive; repeated values OR, fields AND; literal *; no comma splitting or trimming.

parameters.name: target-network
parameters.description: Exact string-array member in the same target as target-account. Case-sensitive; repeated values OR, fields AND; literal *; no comma splitting or trimming.

purpose: Inspect complete native source trees and select sources by predicates on one matching branch.

fields.name: fundNavigationNodeSwitchRequirementVOList
fields.meaning: Requirements, rules, ratios and targets retained together, including all versions and unmatched children.

identity_description: Nonblank native string switchNodeCode; lexical ordering, no guessed composites.
limitations: GET https://ifundcontrolprodops.alipay.com/api/fundNavigation/nodeSwitch/query with URL query pageNo=0,pageSize=1000 only. No backend filters or speculative paging.

Outer success must be boolean true. Native data.businessDataList, integer page echoes, native totalCount and unique source identities establish coverage. totalPageNo is a known zero placeholder and never determines completeness.

1000 is a qualified fixed width, not a measured maximum. SDK checks keep duplicate, conflicting, truncated or overflowing responses incomplete; strict queries reject and incomplete refresh never publishes.

Nested filters must match one requirement and one rule; target-account and target-network must match one target under that rule. A source-network-only predicate requires a child rule. No nested predicates leaves empty source nodes visible.
Filters select whole source trees: no flattening, pruning, external relationship fetch, joining or version merging. Null child arrays traverse as empty while their original values remain unchanged.
All native values, unknown nested fields, precise numbers, null, zero, empty strings and child array order remain unchanged. Ratio scaling, timestamp units and actual execution are not inferred.
Exact local filters precede output windows/projection and never enter requests. Blank inputs reject; accepted values are unchanged, commas remain whole and * is literal.
Live never publishes. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves saved data. No Get, mutation or new Duckdog import contract.

examples.title: Select sources by one rule and target
examples.command: dogopencli payment list rules.bank_switch --status ON --target-network ACH

sync.evidence: Nonblank native string switchNodeCode; lexical ordering, no guessed composites. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
